name: cadence_get_environment
description: Inspect only the host-configured Cadence installation; runtime starts a command-registration probe, not a design session.

name: cadence_get_capabilities
description: Describe implemented experimental features separately from runtime probes and unimplemented workflows.

name: capture_gui_status
description: Read live status when exactly one authenticated host-registered GUI instance is available; use explicit attach for multiple instances.

name: capture_gui_instances
description: Discover and authenticate instances only within host-registered bridge directories; no arbitrary endpoint input.

name: capture_gui_attach
description: Attach a GUI session to one authenticated instance and generation; default read, experimental write requires an explicitly prepared fixture binding.

name: capture_gui_query
description: Read live Capture state, pages or selection through a generation-bound session; never return native pointers.

name: capture_gui_detach
description: Release this logical GUI session without closing or saving the Capture design.

name: capture_gui_plan_note
description: Preview one MCP_NOTE metadata change on an explicitly prepared fixture write session; no electrical property editing.

name: capture_gui_apply_note
description: Apply one immutable fixture note plan, save, reopen in independent workers and compare definition pin nets; ambiguous outcomes are never replayed.

name: capture_gui_jobs
description: List bounded durable note jobs in host-registered private bindings, including after server restart; never replay writes.

name: capture_gui_cancel_note
description: Cancel a pending note plan; started writes cannot be cancelled or rolled back.

name: capture_gui_recover_note
description: Reconcile a started note job without replay: verify a saved result, or retire a still-pending native plan with unchanged file bytes. Lost native context requires manual recovery.

name: capture_gui_diagnose
description: Classify registered bridge/process/design/window/lock failures with recovery actions; read-only and never waits for the GUI operation lock.

name: capture_gui_review_note
description: Produce an independent forensic review of a crashed note job; keeps the lock and requires proof the old Capture process has stopped.

name: capture_gui_resolve_note
description: Explicitly close a crashed job using a fresh review digest; release only its own lock, never edit/replay a design or claim a missing native receipt.

name: pspice_plan_input_check
description: Bind a prepared immutable CIR closure for fixed native parser/setup validation. Does not run analyses or certify numerical results. Explicit includes only; no implicit model-lookup closure certification.

name: pspice_apply_input_check
description: Run fixed PSpiceSetupAnalysis/FINISH/cleanup once in an owned process, reject native OUT errors, verify exact rebased inputs and receipt. Setup success is not solver success.

name: pspice_input_check_jobs
description: Page durable native input-check jobs without execution.

name: pspice_cancel_input_check
description: Cancel a pending input check or this server's active owned worker.

name: pspice_recover_input_check
description: Verify stopped existing input-check artifacts without rerun. A missing native setup receipt cannot be certified from absence of OUT errors.

name: pspice_inspect_input_check
description: Read a successful native setup report after every bound file hash passes. analysisExecuted and solverSuccessVerified remain false.

name: pspice_plan_cli_run
description: Plan the official noninteractive psp_cmd /r on an immutable prepared CIR closure. Fixed installed executable and flags, owned output only. Use backend=cli when opening DAT or inspecting OUT.

name: pspice_apply_cli_run
description: Run official psp_cmd /r once, wait for owned process exit, retain raw output identity, independently read DAT and verify declared samples. Exit0 alone cannot certify success.

name: pspice_cli_run_jobs
description: Page durable official CLI jobs without execution.

name: pspice_cancel_cli_run
description: Cancel a pending or this server's active owned CLI process tree.

name: pspice_recover_cli_run
description: Verify existing stopped CLI artifacts, raw/canonical hashes and declared numerical samples without rerun. Missing completion receipt keeps nativeCompletionVerified false.

name: pspice_plan_run
description: Plan one fixed independent PSpice engine analysis over a prepared immutable CIR closure. Output is a new owned task; no CLI invocation. Optional bounded independent trace-row expectations certify only those declared values. Unsupported file/control directives are refused; implicit model lookup and full SPICE syntax are not certified.

name: pspice_apply_run
description: Run once in an owned process tree, finish/close outputs, independently read DAT and verify declared samples. Never replay a started or failed run.

name: pspice_run_jobs
description: Page durable simulation jobs and terminal errors; no engine launch.

name: pspice_cancel_run
description: Cancel a pending run or this server's active owned process tree; retain uncertain artifacts.

name: pspice_recover_run
description: Verify existing stopped run inputs/OUT/DAT and declared samples; never rerun. Missing native receipt keeps nativeCompletionVerified false.

name: pspice_open_run_dat
description: Open a verified run DAT as an immutable public query snapshot after all job artifact hashes pass. Does not expand public read roots.

name: pspice_inspect_run_output
description: Inspect immutable OUT diagnostics from a verified run; native MEASURE values are not parsed.

name: pspice_inspect_run_failure
description: Read bounded OUT/receipt diagnostics from a stopped failed/cancelled owned run. Binds observation hashes to the task, checks available input closure, never promotes failed outputs or reruns. Explicit diagnostics classify failures; timeout alone does not establish a license fault.

name: pspice_plan_measure_run
description: Plan complete native analysis of one prepared analysis with .MEASURE declarations and independent named value/at/from/to expectations. Native measurements are distinct from sampled DAT statistics; WHEN time is the at field. Fixed PSpiceDoAnalysis entry, new owned output only.

name: pspice_apply_measure_run
description: Run complete native analysis once; verify fresh DAT, complete OUT and every declared measurement result name. Evaluation Failed or mismatched expected fields refuse acceptance.

name: pspice_measure_run_jobs
description: Page durable native measurement jobs without execution.

name: pspice_cancel_measure_run
description: Cancel a pending native measurement run or its active owned process tree.

name: pspice_recover_measure_run
description: Verify stopped existing native measurement outputs without rerunning; missing receipt keeps nativeCompletionVerified false.

name: pspice_inspect_run_measurements
description: Read verified native .MEASURE fields/checks plus conservative field-unit annotations after bound artifact hashes pass. Units derive from simple verified V/I expressions and declared analysis/source sweep; unknown dimensions remain null. Native text contains no native unit metadata; raw numeric evidence and whole-design acceptance remain unchanged.

name: pspice_plan_dat_export
description: Freeze one bound analog trace/range and axis for CSV/JSON export. Includes analog partitions of verified mixed metadata; digital values refuse. Fixed numeric CSV columns, separate unit/provenance manifest, new owned output only. Source run acceptance is preserved as provenance, not a new oracle for exported rows.

name: pspice_apply_dat_export
description: Serialize a frozen DAT range in an owned worker, then independently reopen the copied DAT and verify every exported sample/axis value. Return a hashed data/units/provenance manifest. Started writes never replay.

name: pspice_dat_export_jobs
description: Page durable numeric export jobs without reading or writing samples.

name: pspice_cancel_dat_export
description: Cancel a pending export or this server's active owned serializer; retain incomplete artifacts.

name: pspice_recover_dat_export
description: Verify existing stopped export bytes against its frozen declaration and a fresh native DAT read; never regenerate numeric output. A missing validation manifest may be created after verification. Missing receipt keeps workerCompletionVerified false.

name: pspice_dat_open
description: Import an allowed DAT file and read native analog/digital/mixed block and trace metadata on an isolated immutable copy. Digital aliases/counts are checked separately. Analog samples from completely described mixed blocks are supported; digital logic samples remain unavailable. No simulation or solver-success claim.

name: pspice_dat_query
description: Page imported DAT blocks or exact canonical trace names with aliases. Units report name conventions or unknown, never an undocumented native unit declaration.

name: pspice_dat_samples
description: Read finite analog real/imaginary samples of one exact trace or alias, including the analog partition of a completely described mixed block. Digital traces are rejected before invoking the numeric reader. Bounded paging and snapshot hash checks apply. Native CSV decode is bounded to 100000 rows per trace, including when requesting a small page.

name: pspice_dat_measure
description: Measure finite analog DAT samples. Summary distinguishes sample mean/RMS from axis-weighted piecewise-linear interval mean/RMS and signed trapezoidal area in stored axis order. value_at and first_crossing use piecewise-linear selected-component interpolation in increasing axis; no extrapolation, duplicate axes or discontinuity inference. First crossing may report not-found or plateau. Preserve imported/verified-job provenance; never infer circuit safety or native .MEAS success.

name: pspice_dat_close
description: Release imported DAT registration. Every native read already closes its own file/process; retain copied input and evidence.

name: pspice_inspect_output
description: Read an imported OUT file from configured roots, preserve bytes, and extract coded diagnostics and bias voltage tables. Completion markers cannot prove solver success or association with a current job. Not a waveform/measurement reader.

name: pspice_prepare
description: Prepare a new copied CIR input with bounded explicit .INC/.INCLUDE/.LIB references from configured roots. Preserve original bytes and rewrite references to copied files. No engine run or full syntax/model/implicit-file validation.

name: pspice_get_input
description: Verify hashes of a registered prepared CIR/model snapshot and its preserved originals; this is not a solver result.

name: pspice_close_input
description: Release the server's prepared-input registration; retain all copied evidence files and never touch source inputs.

name: capture_library_open
description: Copy one allowed OLB and read package/device/cell/part/pin definitions in an isolated Dbo worker. Pin numbers are device mappings, not symbol positions. No library mutation or footprint existence check.

name: capture_library_query
description: Page immutable library definitions; exact optional package name, revision-bound cursors, no native pointers. Cell IDs are device-scoped views, not globally deduplicated library identities.

name: capture_query_library_vectors
description: Read basic typed vectors in native draw order for one revision-bound library part. Typed arrays include geometry/style/fill/hatch, text LOGFONT/default classification, and bitmap bounds/location/dimensions/DIB size/SHA256. Bitmap bytes are read in a fixed isolated worker; no native handle is returned. Unsupported kinds fail; no rendered appearance verdict.

name: capture_query_net_symbols
description: Read native global/port/offpage symbol names and host-validated type codes from an immutable OLB session. Snapshot-bound paging; no geometry, placement or electrical verdict.

name: capture_library_close
description: Release this server's copied-library cache; never save or delete a source OLB.

name: cadence_create_workspace
description: Copy one explicitly selected DSN from configured read roots; external project/library/model dependencies are not copied or verified.

name: capture_open
description: Read a registered DSN copy in an isolated Tcl worker; retain an immutable definition snapshot, not a live GUI or writable Dbo session.

name: capture_query
description: Query immutable design definitions with exact reference filtering and revision-bound pagination; occurrence scopes and full hierarchical nets are unavailable.

name: capture_get_hierarchy
description: Read and page occurrence structure and effective component-instance properties; identity is session/revision scoped; instancePathSegments use parent context and complete unit references, while native path/hierarchicalPath may repeat. Bounded traversal rejects cycles/limits instead of returning a truncated tree. Not occurrence-expanded pin/net verification.

name: capture_query_connections
description: Read bounded wire/alias/power/port/offpage/NC definitions and native coordinates, with optional exact pageId and revision-bound pagination. Does not infer junction, bus-member or occurrence connectivity.

name: capture_query_graphics
description: Read native part/graphic/titleblock bounds, text and display-property layout. Display locations are owner-local; cached display bounds may be dirty and their coordinate space/rendered validity is not verified. No automatic clearance verdict.

name: capture_get_occurrence_properties
description: Read one component occurrence's native effective/direct-user properties and its immediate definition's separate property layers and base/full device identity. Select by session/revision hierarchy occurrence ID and full unit path segments. Repeated schematic occurrences remain distinct. Root context properties are explicitly unavailable after a native crash; complete inheritance-source, display layers and connectivity remain unverified.

name: capture_query_page_vectors
description: Read page comment graphics in native order: local typed vector descriptors, full text/font, instance pose and native-transformed page control points. Bitmap byte identity uses the fixed bounded worker. Unmodeled OLE/nested graphics remain explicit unsupported rows. Local text rectangles and control points are not rendered glyph bounds; symbol/titleblock vectors and electrical connectivity remain unchecked.

name: capture_get_part_geometry
description: Read native part location/rotation/mirror codes and actual transformed pin hotspots from a fresh Dbo process. Revision and pin identities must match this immutable definition session; does not assess wiring or rendered text.

name: capture_get_display_font
description: Read the complete effective LOGFONT and default-font inheritance flag for one existing instance display property. Unit identity is native-id bound; rendered bounds and font availability are not certified.

name: capture_plan_display_font
description: Plan a complete explicit font replacement on an existing display property. Unspecified font fields take schema defaults. Require native identity, source and frozen state; verify all instance fonts/default flags and modeled geometry/properties/connections after independent reopen. Cadence-normalized values are rejected rather than silently accepted. No font rendering guarantee.

name: capture_apply_display_font
description: Apply one immutable display-font plan to a new DSN copy, then independently reopen and verify. Never replay a started write.

name: capture_display_font_jobs
description: Inspect persisted display-font tasks.

name: capture_cancel_display_font
description: Cancel a pending or owned running font task; never affect another process.

name: capture_recover_display_font
description: Verify existing stopped font output without repeating the native write.

name: capture_plan_display_property
description: Plan existing display-property owner-local position, native rotation and display type changes. Type codes: 0 hidden, 1 value, 2 name/value, 3 name, 4 both-if-valued. Data/reference values and unrelated displays must stay intact. Font editing is not yet available.

name: capture_apply_display_property
description: Save planned display layout in a new isolated DSN and independently read it back; preserve data properties, unrelated displays and definition pin nets. Mark cached bounds dirty; no rendered-clearance/font verdict.

name: capture_display_property_jobs
description: Page durable isolated display-layout plans/jobs without replay.

name: capture_cancel_display_property
description: Cancel a pending display-layout plan or signal this server's active owned worker; source is unchanged and partial output retained.

name: capture_recover_display_property
description: Verify an existing interrupted display-layout output after proof its worker stopped. Never replay; native completion remains unverified after recovery.

name: capture_plan_cache_replace
description: Plan compatible replacement of the exact source-qualified cache package and every bound instance in a new DSN copy. Declare every affected partId, replacement libraryPartId and complete expected pin/hotspot/net table. Physical pad numbers, package size and device designators stay compatible; connectivity changes, external design parts and typed/source-binding user overrides are refused. Freezes design/library/oracles and modeled identity, effective/user/display state, all instance geometry, cache metadata and connection objects. Full inheritance origins, fonts/rendering and occurrence nets are not certified.

name: capture_apply_cache_replace
description: Replace a cache once on exclusive owned DSN/OLB copies, restore explicit references/string overrides, save and independently reopen all modeled preservation graphs and actual source views. Started mutations never replay; only verified output may be opened with kind=cache_replace.

name: capture_cache_replace_jobs
description: List durable compatible cache replacement task states.

name: capture_cancel_cache_replace
description: Cancel an unstarted task or request stop of this server's owned cache replacement worker.

name: capture_recover_cache_replace
description: After proving the prior worker stopped, verify existing cache replacement bytes only. Never replay replacement or restore missing artifacts.

name: capture_query_cache_binding
description: Read a placed definition's exact DSN cache package by its stored source library and package name. Cross-check native GetCachedPackage identity with the actual placed package, two origin readers and independent instance inventory. Returns only the selected package definitions and distinguishes same-name local/cache entries. Does not open the external source library or certify cache synchronization.

name: capture_query_cache
description: Read the bound DSN's design cache definitions, not an external OLB. Object IDs and cursors belong to this immutable session. Does not prove source-library identity, cache synchronization or external-dependency closure.

name: capture_plan_cached_unit_add
description: Plan one missing device of an existing physical package on its owner page or an explicit targetPageId in the same schematic using a revision-bound cache partId from capture_query_cache. Retains the owner base reference and consistent group Value/Footprint, rejects an occupied device/full reference or conflicting package ownership. Declare every new pin/hotspot/net and existing page pinId. Cross-page plans additionally freeze every original modeled instance geometry and effective/user/display property layer. No external OLB import or new wires. Apply/cancel/recover/open with the existing multiunit placement task family.

name: capture_plan_multiunit_placement
description: Plan all devices of one OLB package under one new base reference on one qualified page. Select one source part per device and declare each unit's full pose/pin/net oracle. Existing page pins use revision-bound pinId, so repeated base references and shared pin numbers remain distinct. Shared physical pads require consistent per-unit net expectations; unresolved local/flat contradictions are refused. Creates no wires; existing connection objects must be preserved. Pin/basic-vector geometry/style/font identity; bitmap and symbol-vector types still refused.

name: capture_apply_multiunit_placement
description: Execute a complete source-package placement or planned missing-device addition from the existing cache. The complete-package path copies DSN/OLB and imports one new cache; the missing-device path copies only DSN and preserves its cache. Independently reopen to verify full references, unit-scoped pins/nets/hotspots, Value/Footprint, connection objects and original page geometry. Complete groups compare source pin/basic-vector views; missing units verify the selected cached view name and unchanged cache pin metadata. No cross-page assignment, full graphic cache, flat/occurrence or DRC certification.

name: capture_multiunit_placement_jobs
description: List durable complete-package placement jobs.

name: capture_cancel_multiunit_placement
description: Cancel a pending or running owned complete-package placement; retain evidence.

name: capture_recover_multiunit_placement
description: Verify a retained complete-package output without repeating native writes.

name: capture_plan_placement
description: Plan a new uniquely referenced instance from an immutable OLB part/device. Declare every new pin's number/name/global hotspot/net and all existing page pin expectations. Verify raw pose without inferring a rotation transform. New private cache package, never replace an existing cache. Multiple source views require an unambiguous source name or pin/basic-vector identity including box/ellipse/arc/ordered polygon/polyline/bezier/fill/text-font fields; other vector kinds are refused. Shared-reference additional units require a dedicated operation.

name: capture_apply_placement
description: Copy DSN and OLB, import a new cache package, place, save and independently reopen. Verify planned pin maps/nets/global hotspots, pose, value, footprint and connection-object preservation. For multiple source views, compare selected source and saved instance pin/basic-vector fields and native draw order in a fresh process. Does not prove bitmap/symbol-vector identity, rendered layout or other unmodeled attributes, external-library-independent cache closure or occurrence behavior.

name: capture_placement_jobs
description: Page durable placement plans/jobs, without mutation replay.

name: capture_cancel_placement
description: Cancel a pending placement or signal this server's active owned native worker; keep isolated evidence.

name: capture_recover_placement
description: Only verify an existing placement output after proof the original worker stopped; no mutation replay or native completion claim.

name: capture_plan_design_create
description: Plan a new empty DSN with one declared root schematic and page, with no existing source design. ASCII names only until non-ASCII native save/reopen is verified. Does not create an OPJ, overwrite an existing design, or imply design/DRC approval.

name: capture_apply_design_create
description: Create one new isolated design, save and independently verify declared definitions, native root and recognized page object counts. sourceFingerprint is a declaration digest, not a prior design-file fingerprint. No started creation is replayed.

name: capture_design_create_jobs
description: List durable new-design creation jobs.

name: capture_cancel_design_create
description: Cancel a pending or currently owned new-design creation job.

name: capture_recover_design_create
description: Verify existing stopped design creation bytes only; never repeat creation.

name: capture_plan_reference_map
description: Plan explicit reference renames/swaps for uniquely referenced single-unit placed definitions. Preserve the existing prefix and pin/net bindings; check final conflicts against unmapped parts. Uses collision-free temporary references for cycles. Multiunit, external, repeated/occurrence and unnumbered automatic allocation are refused or unavailable; not native automatic annotation.

name: capture_plan_package_reference_map
description: Plan whole physical-package base-reference renames/swaps. Each representative expands all placed units in its schematic, including units on other pages. Require verified source-qualified cache ownership and consistent shared pads; preserve NC ownership, complete modeled instance state and old/new pin-node tables. Explicit numbered references only; occurrence mapping and automatic annotation remain unavailable. Apply using capture_apply_reference_map.

name: capture_apply_reference_map
description: Apply one fixed reference map in a new copy via temporary then final names, save and independently verify all definition pin nets, connection objects and affected-page poses/hotspots. Do not replay started writes or certify occurrence nets/display rendering.

name: capture_reference_jobs
description: List durable isolated reference mapping jobs.

name: capture_cancel_reference_map
description: Cancel a pending or currently owned fixed reference map, leaving source unchanged.

name: capture_recover_reference_map
description: Verify existing stopped map bytes only; never repeat temporary/final reference mutation.

name: capture_plan_part_edit
description: Plan a definition-level part pose or deletion in a new copy. Declare all remaining page pin-net expectations and, for pose, every target global hotspot. Preserves wires and other connection objects, checks all page part poses. For a multiunit target, pass expectedConnections=[] and expectedUnitConnections covering remaining page pinIds; native ID/full unit ownership, cache pin metadata, Value/footprint and native page networks are additionally checked. Attached NC, implicit wire dragging and flat/occurrence certification remain unavailable. Rotation/mirror need explicit validated hotspots; no automatic affine oracle.

name: capture_apply_part_edit
description: Execute one fixed part definition edit on a new copy, then independently reopen and verify explicit page nets, poses/hotspots and connection-object baseline. Started writes are never replayed.

name: capture_part_edit_jobs
description: List durable isolated part pose/deletion jobs.

name: capture_cancel_part_edit
description: Cancel a pending or currently owned part edit; source remains unchanged.

name: capture_recover_part_edit
description: Verify existing stopped part edit bytes only; never repeat the mutation.

name: capture_plan_graphic_line_add
description: Plan one decorative graphic line with explicit global endpoints and zero rotation on a new DSN. Does not create an electrical wire. Verify all definition pin nets and connection objects, plus existing target-page line geometry. Style/width/color, other graphic types, page bounds and DRC are not checked.

name: capture_apply_graphic_line_add
description: Add a planned decorative line in an owned copy, save and independently reopen; no source mutation.

name: capture_graphic_line_jobs
description: List durable decorative-line jobs without launching Capture.

name: capture_cancel_graphic_line_add
description: Cancel only the owned planned or active decorative-line operation.

name: capture_recover_graphic_line_add
description: Verify an existing stopped decorative-line artifact; never replay mutation.

name: capture_plan_graphic_text_add
description: Plan literal page text in a new copy. location is the page anchor; width/height are local declared box dimensions, not rendered glyph bounds. Preserve all supported page graphics and modeled existing instance state. Only font quality1 is accepted; no DRC or clipping verdict.

name: capture_apply_graphic_text_add
description: Add a planned page text in an owned copy, save and independently reopen; no source mutation.

name: capture_graphic_text_jobs
description: List durable page-text jobs without launching Capture.

name: capture_cancel_graphic_text_add
description: Cancel only the owned planned or active page-text operation.

name: capture_recover_graphic_text_add
description: Verify an existing stopped page-text artifact; never replay mutation.

name: capture_get_library_pin_style
description: Read eleven native symbol-pin flags for a revision-bound library pin and enumerate all shared symbol scopes. No rendered appearance, DSN cache or electrical-behavior verdict.

name: capture_plan_library_pin_edit
description: Plan a pin name/type/startPoint/hotSpot/visibility symbol edit or a device-local physical pad renumber in a new OLB copy. Preview shows all shared symbol rows affected; partial heterogeneous shared-pad function changes, duplicate pads and shared-pad renumbering are refused. Semantic package/device/cell/part/position identities survive reordered snapshots. Geometry/visibility edits freeze and verify all modeled vectors, declared pin starts and reference templates. Optional style changes long/clock/dot and independently verifies all11 native pin flags across the complete library; preserves modeled graphics and start points. Preview includes the derived global flag for visibility/type changes: power pins remain global, other pins become global when hidden. This symbol flag does not certify instance/flat connectivity. No existing OLB or DSN cache update.

name: capture_apply_library_pin_edit
description: Edit a new OLB copy once, save, independently reopen and compare every package/device/variant/pin metadata row through stable semantics. Geometry/visibility plans also compare modeled graphics, declared pin starts and reference templates. Other plans retain their original verification scope. DSN instances and electrical behavior are not certified. Started mutations are never replayed.

name: capture_library_pin_edit_jobs
description: List durable isolated library pin edit jobs; legacy ordinal plans are not automatically migrated or replayed.

name: capture_cancel_library_pin_edit
description: Cancel a pending or this server's currently owned library pin edit.

name: capture_recover_library_pin_edit
description: Verify existing stopped OLB bytes only. Never repeat an edit; legacy ordinal expectations require explicit migration.

name: capture_open_edited_library
description: Open only a verified, unchanged edited OLB as a fresh query/placement library session, including after server restart. Does not expand public read roots.

name: capture_plan_library_vector_edit
description: Plan an existing basic-vector update or deletion on a new OLB copy. Update takes a full same-kind basic-vector declaration and keeps draw position; delete removes only that position, including an existing bitmap. Untouched bitmap bytes are included in preservation checks. Bitmap geometry update uses bitmapGeometry with bounds, location and expectedDibSha256, preserving dimensions and pixel bytes. Bitmap creation uses the dedicated library-create declaration; pixel replacement remains unavailable. Preview includes all device/package references to the same named native part. Freeze complete modeled definition/vector/template/pin-start expectations. Unknown vectors refuse; unmodeled properties and rendering are not certified.

name: capture_apply_library_vector_edit
description: Edit a new private OLB once; save, independently reopen and verify the declared change and all modeled untouched definitions/vectors in order. Started writes are never replayed.

name: capture_library_vector_edit_jobs
description: Page durable library vector edit jobs without starting native work.

name: capture_cancel_library_vector_edit
description: Cancel a pending or this server's owned library vector edit worker; preserve partial evidence.

name: capture_recover_library_vector_edit
description: Verify existing stopped OLB bytes against frozen vector change/preservation expectations without repeating edits.

name: capture_query_library_package_properties
description: Read fixed package template/designator, PCB library/footprint names and explicit user property text/type/editability flags from an immutable library snapshot. No external footprint or DSN cache verdict.

name: capture_plan_library_package_edit
description: Plan fixed package field changes and explicit string user-property set/empty/delete on a new OLB copy. Freeze all package properties and modeled definitions/vectors/template/pin starts. Package names, devices and pin mappings do not change; built-in property shadowing and typed/locked user edits are refused.

name: capture_apply_library_package_edit
description: Edit one package in a new OLB copy once, save and independently verify requested fields plus all modeled untouched definitions/vectors and every package's explicit user properties. Started edits are never replayed.

name: capture_library_package_edit_jobs
description: List durable isolated package property edit jobs.

name: capture_cancel_library_package_edit
description: Cancel a pending or this server's owned package-property edit worker.

name: capture_recover_library_package_edit
description: Verify existing stopped package-edit output against frozen fields/preservation without repeating native mutation.

name: capture_plan_library_create
description: Plan one new OLB from a single package or a bounded package family. Pin names must be explicit nonempty literals; native auto-generated anonymous names are outside this exact-name declaration. Repeated exact cellName with distinct partName creates alternate symbol views; all views must preserve position/name/electrical-type functions, while geometry/visibility may differ. Device physical maps/shared pads/swap IDs and package footprint/template are independently verified. Optional typed vectors declare line/box/ellipse/arc/polygon/polyline/bezier/fill/text/bitmap in draw order after legacy lines. Bitmap creation requires an allowed sourceBmp path plus independent BMP/DIB SHA256, dimensions and DIB size; exact RGB24/RGB32 bottom-up BMP assets are validated and privately frozen before execution. Geometry/style/font fields are bounded. Text location is bounds top-left. Accepts one package or a packages family of 2..8 independent package variants with disjoint native cell/part namespaces. Total physical pad count is summed per package and excludes extra views; no DSN cache/instance update or external footprint geometry certification.

name: capture_apply_library_create
description: Create once in a new owned OLB, save and independently verify the declared graph and all declared basic vectors in draw order. Never overwrite a source or replay a started operation.

name: capture_library_create_jobs
description: Page durable OLB creation jobs and errors without starting a native process.

name: capture_cancel_library_create
description: Cancel a pending or this server's active owned OLB creation worker; keep partial artifacts unverified.

name: capture_recover_library_create
description: Verify an existing stopped OLB without repeating creation; nativeCompletionVerified stays false on recovery.

name: capture_open_created_library
description: Register only a verified, hash-matching created OLB for normal library query/placement. Does not expand public read roots.

name: capture_plan_wire_edit
description: Plan a two-point scalar wire endpoint edit or deletion on a new DSN. Declare every page pin's result. Endpoint changes require every attached alias's saved anchor; deletion of attached aliases needs explicit acknowledgement. Match native target by unique page/old geometry/net, not an ordinal. No junction/occurrence/DRC verdict.

name: capture_apply_wire_edit
description: Edit/delete one planned scalar wire, save a new DSN and independently verify full definition pin nets and connection-object geometry/aliases. Failed writes are never replayed, and source is unchanged.

name: capture_wire_edit_jobs
description: Page durable wire endpoint/delete jobs; no mutation replay.

name: capture_cancel_wire_edit
description: Cancel pending plans or signal this server's active owned worker; preserve output/evidence.

name: capture_recover_wire_edit
description: Verify existing interrupted wire-edit output after proof original worker stopped. No replay or native-completion claim.

name: capture_plan_wire_add
description: Plan one scalar segment plus an on-wire alias in a new DSN. Require explicit expectations for every page pin. Expected saved paths may declare splits/merges but must preserve the exact old-plus-new geometric union. Defaults keep each old path and add one segment. Expected alias-owner native net defaults to netName, or supply expectedWireNet when an existing canonical name must prevail. No implicit electrical/DRC inference.

name: capture_apply_wire_add
description: Create the planned wire/alias in a new output, save, independently reopen and verify all definition pin nets, declared wire paths/aliases and other connection objects. Source unchanged; never replay a started job. Does not verify occurrence or wire-only net identity.

name: capture_wire_add_jobs
description: Page durable wire-add plans/jobs, including after server restart. No mutation replay.

name: capture_cancel_wire_add
description: Cancel a pending wire plan or signal this server's owned active worker; retain partial output/evidence.

name: capture_recover_wire_add
description: Verify an existing interrupted wire output only after its original worker is proven stopped. Never replay mutation; no native completion claim after recovery.

name: capture_plan_user_property
description: Plan explicit user-metadata creation/update/deletion on an unambiguous part in a new copy. Set requires value (empty is retained); delete requires an existing user property and an exact effective fallback expectation (null means absent). Native identity/model/source fields are protected.

name: capture_apply_user_property
description: Apply a user-property plan to a new DSN, save and independently verify explicit/user effective results, unrelated user properties and definition pin nets. Never edits the source or replays a started job.

name: capture_user_property_jobs
description: Page durable user-property plans/jobs in this host workspace, including after server restart; never replay.

name: capture_cancel_user_property
description: Cancel a pending user-property plan or signal this server's active owned worker. Query durable jobs for final state; no source change or rollback.

name: capture_recover_user_property
description: Only verify an existing interrupted user-property output after proof its worker stopped; no replay. Native completion remains unverified after recovery.

name: capture_open_edit_result
description: Open a verified isolated edit output as a fresh immutable session for chained operations, including after server restart. No arbitrary path/root expansion; reject unverified or changed artifacts.

name: capture_plan_hierarchy_clone
description: Plan same-page reuse of a resolved top-level internal block; new boundary pins must remain unbound. Explicit hotspots required. External and nested sources unsupported.

name: capture_apply_hierarchy_clone
description: Reuse an internal block in a new DSN, save/reopen and verify declared geometry, definitions, tree, original occurrence properties and native flat partitions. Never replay started work.

name: capture_hierarchy_clone_jobs
description: Page durable hierarchy reuse jobs without replay.

name: capture_cancel_hierarchy_clone
description: Cancel a pending or this server's active owned hierarchy reuse worker; retain partial artifacts.

name: capture_recover_hierarchy_clone
description: Verify existing stopped hierarchy output only; never repeat native mutation or claim recovered native completion.

name: capture_plan_nc_edit
description: Plan NC add/remove on one unbound scalar pin of an internal single-unit placed part. Bind immutable source, pin identity, old flag and hotspot; no source edits.

name: capture_apply_nc_edit
description: Apply NC state on a new output and independently verify full definitions, connection objects and affected-page geometry. Never replay started work.

name: capture_nc_edit_jobs
description: Page durable NC edit jobs without mutation replay.

name: capture_cancel_nc_edit
description: Cancel pending or this server's active owned NC worker; keep partial evidence.

name: capture_recover_nc_edit
description: Verify an existing stopped NC output without reapplying a flag; native completion stays unproven on recovery.

name: capture_plan_net_symbol_edit
description: Plan scalar attached global/offpage rename/delete on a new copy. Declare native owning wire; preserve full page pin/wire memberships and unrelated names. Optional explicit saved wire name oracle; deletion otherwise permits auto naming. Pose and cross-page flat connectivity remain unverified.

name: capture_apply_net_symbol_edit
description: Edit one scalar net symbol on an isolated output and independently verify object semantics, part geometry and native page net memberships; never replay started work.

name: capture_net_symbol_edit_jobs
description: Page durable scalar net symbol jobs without replay.

name: capture_cancel_net_symbol_edit
description: Cancel a pending or this server's active owned net symbol edit worker; retain uncertain output.

name: capture_recover_net_symbol_edit
description: Verify existing stopped net symbol output without repeating mutation or claiming recovered native completion.

name: capture_plan_alias_edit
description: Plan standalone scalar alias name/anchor edit or deletion. Preserve native page pin/wire memberships; no intentional net merges. Deletion may generate a new native net name without changing connections.

name: capture_apply_alias_edit
description: Edit one scalar alias on an isolated output and independently verify object semantics, part geometry and native page net memberships; never replay started work.

name: capture_alias_edit_jobs
description: Page durable scalar alias jobs without replay.

name: capture_cancel_alias_edit
description: Cancel a pending or this server's active owned alias edit worker; retain uncertain output.

name: capture_recover_alias_edit
description: Verify existing stopped alias output without repeating mutation or claiming recovered native completion.

name: capture_plan_net_symbol_create
description: Plan source-bound global/offpage glyph creation with explicit origin/hotspot and every page pin expectation. Optional orthogonal lead must end at one unbound internal single-unit pin. No cross-page/global-flat verdict.

name: capture_apply_net_symbol_create
description: Create copied net symbol/optional lead on a fresh DSN; independently verify full definitions, objects, page geometry and selected native symbol/wire/pin binding. Never replay started work.

name: capture_net_symbol_create_jobs
description: Page durable source-bound net-symbol jobs without replay.

name: capture_cancel_net_symbol_create
description: Cancel a pending or this server's active owned net-symbol worker; retain partial output.

name: capture_recover_net_symbol_create
description: Verify existing stopped net-symbol output and source hashes, never recreate the symbol or claim recovered native completion.

name: capture_plan_property
description: Plan one existing approved Value/PCB Footprint/Implementation/TC1/TC2 change on an unambiguous part definition. Implementation requires an existing PSpice Model type. Model identifiers and finite decimal coefficients are bounded; new plans also freeze the complete effective-property multiset. Model existence and simulation behavior require separate validation. Apply always creates a new isolated DSN; never edits the source or a GUI design. Shared references/multi-unit edits require a dedicated operation.

name: capture_apply_property
description: Apply a durable property plan to a new DSN copy, save, independently reopen and check the explicit value plus pre-change definition pin nets. Owned process tree, no replay of started jobs. New plans also verify the complete effective-property multiset. Does not resolve external model definitions or validate electrical behavior/DRC/occurrence nets.

name: capture_property_jobs
description: Page durable isolated property jobs after server restart; read statuses without replay. New jobs can change listing order while paging.

name: capture_cancel_property
description: Cancel a pending isolated plan, or signal this server's active owned process tree. Source is never modified; retain partial output. Query jobs for final cancellation state; no rollback/replay.

name: capture_recover_property
description: Verify an existing failed/interrupted output only after proof its worker stopped. Never reapply. Recovery may verify the artifact while nativeCompletionVerified remains false.

name: capture_get_property_layers
description: Read effective values, explicit user properties and display-property values/owner-local positions separately. Does not infer a full library/cache/occurrence inheritance chain or editability.

name: capture_get_part_properties
description: Read up to 512 effective properties of one revision-bound part definition in a fresh Dbo worker. Use partId from capture_query; includes inherited effective values without asserting their origin or editability. No GUI or mutation.

name: capture_snapshot
description: Write an immutable JSON snapshot artifact in its registered workspace; it is not an independently verified connectivity baseline.

name: capture_check_wiring
description: Read wire polylines in a fresh standalone worker and write an exact linear geometry advisory, including diagonal crossings/overlaps. Non-integer crossings use pointExact rational coordinates. Optional gridSize/gridOrigin check vertices in native units; absent grid means no grid verdict. No GUI/PDF, junction or electrical verdict. Limited to 2000 segments/10000 vertices/findings.

name: capture_compare_connections
description: Compare explicit named pin expectations against a revision-bound immutable Dbo snapshot and write a report. Exact names only; ambiguous definitions stay unverified. No occurrence/net-equivalence/DRC verdict; never generate expectations from observations.

name: capture_close
description: Release this server's cached read-only session; never save, delete a design, or touch a Capture GUI session.
